summary: A Dubai property company appears to lose enquiries to a listed email that seems not to receive mail, a spelling error in its name and a free builder address.

findings.problem: The site lists info@alhilalaljameelbrokerge.com, but that web domain appears not to exist, so mail sent there would bounce.
findings.cost: Every client who writes to the main email address is lost, and you never see the enquiry.
findings.fix: A working email on a real domain.

findings.problem: The business name appears as Brokerge, a misspelling of Brokerage, in the page title and in the web address.
findings.cost: A spelling error in the firm's own name weakens trust in a property business.
findings.fix: The correct name and a clean domain.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner and a 2021 copyright date.
findings.cost: A free builder address and an old date look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a current page.

findings.problem: The page appears to show stray characters near the contact section, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Stray text looks unfinished, and renters who want a quick answer have no easy way to message.
findings.fix: A clean contact section and a one tap WhatsApp button.
